nodes.description: Address of the contract owner; used in onlyOwner modifier and receives payout share.
Monotonically increasing index of the current game round.
Accumulated sum of all player payments in the current game.
Lock flag controlling whether the fallback (join game) is allowed.
Pending ContractParam configuration set by the owner.
Active ContractParam configuration (price, size, pump rate).
Array of player addresses participating in the current game.
Constructor: sets owner from msg.sender and initializes both configs, then starts a new game.
owner-only function toggling isLock; stops or restarts the game accordingly.
Private function distributing the contract balance equally to all players in a loop.
owner-only ownership transfer to a non-zero address.
owner-only payable function staging new game parameters into setConfig.
Private function incrementing gameIndex, syncing setConfig into curConfig and clearing players.
Public view returning game state (index, config, players, totalPrice, isLock).

Modifier restricting execution to msg.sender == owner.

External caller address; used for ownership checks and player registration.
Block timestamp (now) used as randomness seed and emitted in gameOverEvent.
Batch of external value transfers to every player address inside the stopGame loop.
External transfer of the pump-rate share to the owner address.
External transfer of the remaining balance to a player-controlled winner address.
Inline assembly reading extcodesize(addr) as a contract-detection heuristic.
Pseudo-randomness derived from keccak256 of blockhash/now/players, predictable by miners.
Unchecked accumulation totalPrice = totalPrice + msg.value without SafeMath.

Local size variable holding extcodesize result.

Local snapshot of address(this).balance in gameResult.
Owner share computed as totalBalace * pumpRate / 100.
Winner share computed as totalBalace - giveToOwn.
Accumulating bytes32 randomness seed in getRamdon.
Loop counter mixing player addresses into the randomness seed.
Final index = uint(ramdon) % addressArray.length returned to gameResult.
